control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: injury during cleaning and preparation on CY-3212

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on CY-3212 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on CY-3212 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. CY-3212 (cyclone clusters) is in service for classification duty on the grinding circuit. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 7 September 2025 an incident occurred on CY-3212 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
